name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Mid-Market Account Executive | Full-Cycle B2B Sales, Merchant Growth & Commerce
summary: Full-cycle B2B account executive with 7+ years carrying a number across SaaS, MarTech, and agency sales, selling to business owners and executives on customer acquisition, conversion, and growth. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, earning into accelerator tiers with $20K+ mid-market deals. Held 120% of sales targets at Wix while launching e-commerce storefronts for established retail brands, contributing to a 25% conversion improvement across the e-commerce segment. Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K at Fetch & Funnel and reached finalist stage with a major northeastern U.S. bank. Builds pipeline through outbound, research, and referrals, and brings a merchant's-eye view of what drives conversion.

Build business cases tied to each client's acquisition and conversion goals, and report results against them on a regular cadence.
